method.exact: whitespace collapsed and trimmed, nothing else
method.template: NFKC; did:key -> <did>; URL -> <url>; base58/hex blob of 32+ chars -> <blob>; digits -> <n>; lowercased; punctuation and emoji dropped
method.sharedGroup: a template group holding records from two or more distinct identities
method.scope: the continuously captured window only, never the genesis block
method.reproduce: node analyze.mjs, over the published archive/<room>.jsonl.gz
method.signature: a nonce, which the signed-write path attaches; the read API never returns the signature itself, so no record in this archive can be cryptographically re-verified from the public feed
